func (s *APIV1Service) dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook(ctx context.Context, memo *v1pb.Memo, activityType string) error {

h06.

**Handlers (≥3):** `CreateMemo`, `UpdateMemo`, `DeleteMemo` (and also `CreateMemoComment`) — all on `APIV1Service` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` and `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go`.

**Convergence function:** `Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go`

These memo RPC handlers can transitively POST to user-configured webhook URLs (`hook.Url` from `GetUserWebhooks`). The only outbound HTTP to such URLs in this repo is the webhook path; `webhook.Post` is where every path converges immediately before delivery (`http.NewRequest` + `safeClient.Do` at ```119:152:internal/webhook/webhook.go```).

| Handler | Call chain |
|---|---|
| **`CreateMemo`** (`memo_service.go`) | → `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` → `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` → `GetUserWebhooks` → `payload.URL = hook.Url` → `webhook.PostAsync` → worker → **`Post`** |
| **`UpdateMemo`** (`memo_service.go`) | → `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (`memo_update_helpers.go`) → `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` → same shared dispatch → **`Post`** |
| **`DeleteMemo`** (`memo_service.go`) | → `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` → same shared dispatch → **`Post`** |
| **`CreateMemoComment`** (`memo_service_comments.go`) | → internal `CreateMemo` (comment-author webhooks) + `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` (parent-memo-owner webhooks) → both call `webhook.PostAsync` → **`Post`** |

Shared dispatch logic (URL assignment + enqueue) lives in ```48:72:server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go```; async workers drain the queue and call `Post` in ```42:54:internal/webhook/webhook.go```.
